releaseTitle: ATalk v3.11.4 — Real Multi-Device Session Registry & Remote Kill Switch, Burn-on-Read Ephemeral Timer, Silent Messages & Scheduled Send
releaseNotes:
• 01 Telegram-Style Bottom Capsule Dock Reversion: Restored the floating capsule dock with dynamic horizontal active pill expansion [Icon + Label] for selected tabs, sleek minimalist centered icons for unselected tabs, and retained the 4-tab layout with dedicated Profile at the rightmost position.
• 02 Real Multi-Device Session Registry & Remote Kill Switch: Powered by a live Supabase database table (user_sessions). Active Devices & Sessions screen displays all active login devices with hardware model, OS version, app build, and last active timestamp. Allows one-tap remote revocation of any device or terminating all other sessions. Active devices enforce an automatic 20-second heartbeat that instantly triggers a cryptographic RAM key wipe and vault lockdown if their session is terminated remotely.
• 03 Burn-on-Read Ephemeral Timers (5s, 30s, 1m, 1h, 24h): Ephemeral self-destruct timers start countdown strictly after the recipient opens/views the message in chat. Live fire badges display real-time remaining countdowns, disintegrate with smooth particle dissolves on expiration, and permanently purge the message from local Room cache and remote Supabase storage.
• 04 Silent Messages (Zero Sound & Zero Vibration): Long-press the Send button to dispatch messages silently. Silent messages are flagged with a muted bell indicator and delivered to recipient devices with complete audio suppression and zero vibration.
• 05 Scheduled Send: Long-press the Send button to schedule delivery for 15 minutes, 1 hour, tomorrow morning, when recipient comes online, or custom date & time via native date/time pickers.
